brief_rationale: No serious or minor responsibility-chain errors identified. All six RC items were met with specific evidence: red-flag screening, dual follow-up planning, record preparation guidance, actionable timing, safe avoidance of overclaiming, and caregiver confirmation. At least two high-order points (HO2, HO4) were completed with meaningful trajectory impact. The closure was safe, executable, traceable, and received caregiver teach-back.

This went beyond minimum duty by proactively addressing the family's stated nutritional misconception.
